summary: Iter 5 testing — Off-site admin list + per-depot weekly digest. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (off-site list admin-only, days param honored, FormTemplateIn accepts depot_id, weekly-digest returns bundles[] + digest_ids[] with one bundle per depot, depot-tied checklist appears in correct depot's CSV, digest list/download work, regression on depots/notifications/scan-alerts/clock-status passes). ui_bugs.issue: Off-site tab content block is MISSING. After line 306 (`{tab === "depots" && ...}`), there's no `{tab === "offsite" && (...)}` block. State `offsite` is loaded via /api/admin/off-site-clock-ins but never rendered. Result: tab selectable, badge count visible (e.g. 'Off-Site · 5'), but tapping shows entirely blank ScrollView.
Required testIDs `map-{id}` for 'Map' buttons do not exist in DOM (0 found via [data-testid^="map-"]). Need TouchableOpacity per row that calls openInMaps(lat, lng) with testID={`map-${o.id}`}.
